name: Obsidian
soft_passes: #2 optical centring reads slightly high — crystal base terminates near the vertical midline, not below it; within tolerance
#4 16px squint — internal facet seams smear to one violet blob; mark survives on colour+silhouette, but the cut-gem detail is a >64px story

#10 variant robustness — not authored as Liquid Glass layers; light-lavender faces + violet ramp depend on the dark field and would wash on clear/light or flatten under tint; solid silhouette alone yields a usable mono variant, so it clears the silhouette bar but the colour story is background-bound

palette.background: ramp #252525->#1A1A1A (graphite squircle, subtle top-down vignette; achromatic)
palette.accent: none (the violet glyph is the accent; no second hue)

light_model: top / upper-left; facet gradients brighten to a near-white specular catch on the upper-left face and darken toward the base, consistent across every facet; background field marginally lighter at top; baked, short, soft — no resolvable cast shadow
layer_stack: upper facets + specular highlight (light lavender -> near-white)
devices: low-poly gem rendered as flat linear-gradient faces (cut reads from gradient-direction seams, not texture)
near-white specular catch on the upper-left facet
monochrome-violet ramp as the entire chromatic budget on a neutral-dark field
rhymes_hint: dark-tile brand-glyph family (one luminous saturated object centred on a graphite squircle, no tool overlay) and the faceted-object / low-poly-gem logo cluster (colour + silhouette carry it, monochrome hue on neutral dark)
notes: Source is a 204x204 WebP web render, not a 1024 master — facet edges soft from compression, boundary hex approximate, any baked drop shadow below resolution floor. Squircle corners are PRE-MASKED in this render (corners already black), so this is the final composite, not unmasked Icon Composer layers. Strong icon<->brand palette coherence: cover subtitle purple ~#A88BFA matches the glyph mid-violet (#A683EC), both on near-black (#070707 cover / graphite squircle), confirming the violet-on-dark identity is systematic across the app's brand, not just the icon. Era read as big-sur (uniform dark squircle, front-facing baked-gradient glyph, no glass specular/refraction/translucency); check #10 scoped to Liquid Glass and flagged rather than failed since this is an earlier-era mark.
